scope: Additive current-source follow-up for required Super Yeti Electromite; preserves its unmaterializable status while recording corroborated secondary observations.
game_version: Public official and secondary sources consulted on 2026-09-20; no immutable client build for Electromite was published.

sources.title: Mini Spotlight Event: Super Yeti!
sources.limitations: Establishes the Super Yeti/Electromite feature as Home Village content but provides no Electromite stat table, threshold, spawning, targeting, chain or lifecycle contract.

sources.title: Super Yeti/Electromite
sources.limitations: Reports L3-L8 72/78/84/88/90/92 damage and 400/450/500/550/575/590 HP, a 400-parent-damage threshold, building x4, 24 speed, 2 range, three targets and 20% chain decay. It supplies no immutable build, child mapping proof, spawn coordinate/time, chain geometry/selection, self-destruction delay, wall path or tick ordering.

sources.title: Super Yeti
sources.limitations: Corroborates the L3-L8 child damage/HP table, x4 building damage, 24 speed, 2 range, ground/air target type and damage-triggered release. It does not publish the 400 threshold, an immutable build or deterministic lifecycle.

sources.title: Super Yeti
sources.limitations: Provides a dated build claim for the parent only; it does not publish an Electromite table, threshold, spawn or chain contract.

known_uncertainties: The new unversioned Electromite page says every 400 parent damage, while the already preserved parent-page evidence says first 400 then every 800; no build-pinned trace resolves the conflict.

No consulted source defines the child level mapping, parent-damage accumulation and multi-threshold behavior, capacity relation, spawn coordinate/time, path/jump/collision, target selection, chain geometry, self-destruction delay or same-tick ordering.
No source-verified Electromite asset path or visual tier is available.
conclusion: The 20 September review corroborates an unversioned Electromite L3-L8 stat table but does not resolve the threshold contradiction or provide a deterministic lifecycle. Electromite remains required inventory only; no GameData child, spawn queue or chain proxy is enabled.
